declared_proposition: For every r>=2, k>=2, and t>=0, the primitive accelerated-Collatz word w_(r,k,t)=1^k 2^(2k+t)(1 2^2)^(r-1), and every cyclic rotation, fails the affine divisibility equation. Thus an unbounded one-sided L1 deformation ray from every TICKET-201 base word contains no positive Collatz cycle code.
mathematical_argument: Put n=r-1 and q=k+n. Direct concatenation gives D=4^t32^q-3^t27^q and the exact identity 5B-23D=2*27^n E_(k,t), where E_(k,t)=14*3^t27^k-5*3^t18^k-9*4^t32^k=-F_(k,t). For t=0, positivity of F is TICKET-201's residual inequality. For t>=1 and k>=2, 14*3^t27^k<9*4^t32^k follows from the worst case t=1,k=2, so F>0. Also D>=4^t32^(k+1)-3^t27^(k+1)>F because the remaining difference is 23*4^t32^k-13*3^t27^k-5*3^t18^k>0. Since D is coprime to 6*27^n, D|B would force D|E, contradicting 0<|E|<D. A unique long 2-run proves primitivity, and the standard rotation recurrence transfers nondivisibility to every rotation.

reproducible_computation.no_go_scope: The theorem closes an unbounded one-sided deformation ray, not a full L1 ball. Shortening the run, moving mass between positions, arbitrary valuation words, and nonperiodic divergence remain open.

discarded_route: treating each nonnegative central-run extension as a separate experiment
remaining_gap: Only a one-sided single-block deformation ray is closed; a uniform multisite L1 neighborhood and arbitrary words remain open.
claim_boundary: No Collatz proof and no nontrivial cycle. One explicit three-parameter family and all rotations are excluded.
